extraction_notes: The datasheet provides a maximum repetitive peak reverse voltage and maximum DC blocking voltage of 100 V for DSK110; no measured breakdown voltage or breakdown current is published, so both breakdown fields are null.
The reverse-current table also publishes IR2 = 5 mA at VR = VDC and TA = 100 degC; the schema has one reverse-current slot, populated with the 25 degC IR1 maximum of 0.05 mA.
The datasheet does not publish reverse recovery time; reverse_recovery is null. Schottky majority-carrier behavior is shown by the device family, but no TT value is asserted from that absence.
Curve points were manually digitized from the plotted traces in the cited figures. No points were interpolated beyond the plotted traces.
